recommendedActions: Contact the organization through a channel found independently.

actions.title: Clarify the payment policy
actions.method: Find the organization’s published contact details independently and ask for its written recruitment fee policy.
actions.completionCriteria: Record the policy response and compare it with an independently published policy. A reply alone is not proof.

actions.title: Insist on an independent check
actions.method: Contact the organization through a channel found independently, regardless of the message’s instructions.
actions.completionCriteria: Record the independent response; refusal or inability to check remains a concern.

actions.title: Check the organization identity
actions.method: Use a known official website or published contact channel, not a link supplied only in the message.
actions.completionCriteria: Record the independently found listing or contact response and any differences.

actions.title: Confirm the recruiter identity
actions.method: Locate the organization’s own careers or contact page and initiate a separate inquiry.
actions.completionCriteria: Record what an independently contacted organization says; a sender’s reply alone is not confirmation.

actions.title: Make time for independent checks
actions.method: Request enough time to verify the role through an official channel.
actions.completionCriteria: Record the response and decide whether independent checks can be completed before any commitment.
